Name: SNES Rabites of Mana
Author: cryomancer199x
Description:
Hello I do not know what I am doing so lemme know if there's problems.

This mod adds six colors of Rabites as barn animals. Rabites are cute enemies from the * of Mana games. These ones act mostly like pigs and will find a new food item, Gumdrop Candy, for you.  They also have baby sprites but it's just recolored baby rabbits. Some frames of animations may or may not be weird? They looked OK in my testing.  I dunno if it's compatible or incompatible with anything in particular but I was testing them with like 200 mods on without any obvious issues I could find. Gumdrop Candy is a universal like, because I couldn't quite wrap my head around individual NPC taste appending.

Sprites are from a few different Mana games, colors and sprites are mildly interpreted and tweaked. Thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/PrimmR/about-me?gameId=1303]PrimmR[/url] for the purple color scheme.

Version 2: mostly just a sanitizing update, hopefully executed properly. Set sleep frames, and fixed some stuff with the white rabite texture. Also added config and i18n support. You can use the config or GMCM to swap between gumdrops or faerie walnuts now, so i'm archiving the optional file. Let me know if anything's busted. Will probably need to get new rabites if loading an old save, sorry. Sell your old ones first, probably.

Translators, feel free to translate.

Downloads.Description: Version 2 adding various minor things. Adds seven colors of Rabite to buy for your barn.
